Name: Fast
Description: Only do a quick first pass. Does not actually test visibility.

Name: Radius Override
Description: Force a maximum vis radius, in units, regardless of whether an env_fog_controller specifies one.

Name: Threads
Description: Override the number of CPU threads used.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Force VVIS to run as a low-priority process.

Name: Normal Priority
Description: Run process with a normal process priority (be default below normal). Will prevent process from getting run on an efficiency core for certain CPUs
Warning: Using above normal process priority can cause other applications to become slow/unresponsive

Name: Verbose
Description: Turn on verbose output for debug purposes.

Name: Insert Search Path
Description: Add an extra search path in front of the ones from gameinfo.txt, so its content wins over the game's. Several paths can be given separated by commas.

Name: Append Search Path
Description: Add an extra search path behind the ones from gameinfo.txt, for content the game does not already have. Several paths can be given separated by commas.
